about_the_game:
[OFFICIAL MESSAGE – SAFE ZONE CORP.]

Welcome to SAFE ZONE.

This environment has been carefully designed to ensure your well-being. Your cooperation is essential for the successful completion of the experiment.

Safe Zone is a platforming experience with psychological and narrative elements. You will undergo a series of simulations where death is not a failure, but part of the process. The goal is not to survive — it is to understand.

MARA, our artificial intelligence assistant, will guide you at all times. She knows what you need.

Experiment features:

  • 2D platform simulations with mechanics based on observation, trial and adaptation

  • Symbolic and emotional narrative with multiple layers of interpretation

  • Minimalist design to eliminate unnecessary distractions

  • Speedrun mode authorized for subjects with high stress tolerance

  • Available languages: Spanish (optimized Andalusian version) and English

In the end, everything will be okay. And if it’s not okay... it’s not the end.

— SAFE ZONE CORP.

Thank you for your participation.

content_descriptors.notes: This game explores psychological themes such as anxiety, depression, and the desire to give up, including metaphorical references to death and despair. However, it does not contain graphic violence, sexual content, or real-world depictions of self-harm. The content is presented in a symbolic and abstract way, through minimalist visuals and short narrative texts.
